review.why: Writes or rewrites a complete resume as copy-ready text from the user's facts, with a working ledger and open questions.
review.summary: Establishes the brief, builds a ledger of employers, official titles, dates and credentials with the source of each claim, turns contradictions into questions, then drafts sections in reverse chronology with a supported headline and a short summary. It returns the resume, the material edits and the unresolved questions, and does not claim layout checks it did not run.
strengths: Contradictions become questions, never a silently chosen version
A desired senior title is never turned into a title already held
A missing metric is not filled from an example or a job ad
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Page count and PDF parsing stay unverified unless the exported file is inspected
Specialized cases are handed to sibling skills
